guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: recommendationservice shows the largest anomalies (latency-90 +12000%, z=+2400; cpu +620%, z=+52.8; mem +544%, z=+22.3), and its downstream productcatalogservice is flat (cpu -10.6%, latency-50 +6%), so the fault originates in recommendationservice itself and propagates up to frontend latency (+286%). CPU and memory both rose, but CPU saturation is the more likely driver of the latency, and memory growth could be a side effect or a separate fault, so I am not highly confident in distinguishing cpu from mem; logs contain no warnings or errors and offer no tie-breaker.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or scale out recommendationservice (add CPU limit headroom/replicas) and inspect its recent profile for a CPU hot loop or memory growth; the conntrack runbook excerpt is unrelated to the observed evidence and not acted on.
